content: For browser camera barcode scanning in 2026: native BarcodeDetector API (Chrome/Edge/Android, not Safari/iOS) is fastest when available; ZXing-js (via wrapper libs) has broadest format support but is in maintenance mode; Quagga2 is a solid pure-JS fallback for 1D barcodes (UPC/EAN) with rotation/scale tolerance but has known camera-init issues on some devices. Given Patron/Bartender are iPad Safari and Barback is a phone browser, BarcodeDetector cannot be relied on for iOS Safari, so a JS fallback library (Quagga2 or a ZXing wrapper) is needed for cross-device reliability. UPC/EAN-13 is the target 1D format for liquor bottles.
